title: Campfires Burning
tune: Tune: “Frère Jacques” · sing it as a three-part round

blocks.text:
Campfires burning, campfires burning,
Draw nearer, draw nearer,
In the glowing, in the glowing,
Come sing and be merry.
Split into three groups. The second starts when the first reaches “draw nearer”, the third when the second does.

title: Ging Gang Goolie
tune: Tune: traditional — the oldest Scout campfire chant there is

blocks.text:
Ging gang gooli gooli gooli gooli watcha,
Ging gang goo, ging gang goo.
Ging gang gooli gooli gooli gooli watcha,
Ging gang goo, ging gang goo.

Heyla, heyla sheyla, heyla sheyla, heyla ho,
Heyla, heyla sheyla, heyla sheyla, heyla ho.

Shalli-walli, shalli-walli, shalli-walli, shalli-walli,
Oompa, oompa, oompa, oompa.
It means nothing at all — that's the point. Once through slowly, then as fast as you can manage.

title: There Ain't No Flies On Us
tune: Tune: “The Girl I Left Behind Me” · point at the other patrol

blocks.text:
There ain't no flies on us,
There ain't no flies on us.
There might be flies on some of you guys,
But there ain't no flies on us!
Patrol against patrol — swap “you guys” for the other mob's name.

title: Singing In The Rain
tune: Tune: “Singin' in the Rain” · add one action each time through

blocks.text:
We're singing in the rain, just singing in the rain,
What a glorious feeling, we're happy again.
_Hang about!_

Thumbs up! _(everyone echoes)_
A-root-ta-ta, root-ta-ta, root-ta-ta-TA!

blocks.heading: Add each in turn, keeping the last

blocks.text: By the last verse nobody can sing a word — that's when you stop.

title: Boom Chicka Boom
tune: Spoken, not sung — the leader calls each line, everyone repeats it

blocks.text:
I said a-boom-chicka-boom,
I said a-boom-chicka-boom,
I said a-boom-chicka-rocka-chicka-rocka-chicka-boom.
Uh-huh! Oh yeah!
One more time, _(name a)_ style!

blocks.heading: Styles to call
items: **Flower:** I said a bloom chicka bloom, I said a bloom chicka blossom smell those flowers chicka bloom.
**Race car:** I said a vroom shifta vroom, I said a vroom shifta grind-a shifta grind-a shifta vroom.
**Astronaut:** I said a moon shoot the moon, I said a moon blast-me shoot-me blast-me shoot-me-to-the-moon.
**Fire:** I said an OUCH chicka OUCH, I said an OUCH burnt my finger in the fire chicka OUCH.

blocks.text: Then invent your own: underwater, opera, slow-motion, Cub style.

title: Alice The Camel
tune: Tune: traditional · count down from five, bump hips on every “boom”

blocks.text:
Alice the camel has five humps,
Alice the camel has five humps,
Alice the camel has five humps,
So go, Alice, go — boom, boom, boom!
Repeat with four humps, three, two, one…

Alice the camel has no humps,
Alice the camel has no humps,
Alice the camel has no humps,
'Cos Alice is a horse!

title: Meat Balls Song
tune: Tune: “On Top of Old Smoky”

blocks.text:
On top of spaghetti,
All covered with cheese,
I lost my poor meatball,
When somebody sneezed.

It rolled off the table,
And on to the floor,
And then my poor meatball,
Rolled out of the door.

It rolled in the garden,
And under a bush,
And then my poor meatball,
Was nothing but mush.

The mush was as tasty,
As tasty could be,
And then the next summer,
It grew into a tree.

The tree was all covered,
All covered with moss,
And on it grew meatballs,
And tomato sauce.

So if you eat spaghetti,
All covered with cheese,
Hold on to your meatball,
Whenever you sneeze!

title: Kum Ba Yah
tune: Tune: traditional spiritual · slow, soft, one verse at a time

blocks.text:
Kum ba yah, my Lord, kum ba yah,
Kum ba yah, my Lord, kum ba yah,
Kum ba yah, my Lord, kum ba yah,
O Lord, kum ba yah.

Someone's crying, Lord, kum ba yah… _(×3)_
O Lord, kum ba yah.

Someone's singing, Lord, kum ba yah… _(×3)_
O Lord, kum ba yah.

Someone's praying, Lord, kum ba yah… _(×3)_
O Lord, kum ba yah.

title: Grand Old Duke Of York
tune: Tune: traditional marching song · stand on “up”, sit on “down”

blocks.text:
Oh, the Grand old Duke of York,
He had ten thousand men,
He marched them up to the top of the hill,
And he marched them down again.

And when they were up, they were up,
And when they were down, they were down,
And when they were only half way up,
They were neither up nor down.
Faster each time round until everyone collapses.

title: Bingo
tune: Tune: traditional · one more clap replaces one more letter

blocks.text:
There was a dog in my back yard,
And Bingo was his name-o.
B—I—N—G—O,
B—I—N—G—O,
B—I—N—G—O,
And Bingo was his name-o.

blocks.heading: How it builds
items: Right through to five claps and no letters at all.

title: A Pizza Hut
tune: Spoken chant · a hand shape for every food

blocks.text:
A pizza hut, a pizza hut,
Fried chicken and a pizza hut.
A pizza hut, a pizza hut,
Fried chicken and a pizza hut.

Burger bar, burger bar,
Fried chicken and a pizza hut.
Burger bar, burger bar,
Fried chicken and a pizza hut.

blocks.heading: The hands
items: **Pizza hut** — draw a roof-shaped triangle in the air.
**Fried chicken** — flap your elbows like wings.
**Burger bar** — draw a big “M” with both hands.

title: Kookaburra Song
tune: Tune: traditional Australian round · four parts if you're brave

blocks.text:
Kookaburra sits in the old gum tree,
Merry, merry king of the bush is he.
Laugh, Kookaburra, laugh, Kookaburra,
Gay your life must be.

Kookaburra sits on an electric wire,
Jumping up and down with his pants on fire.
Ouch, Kookaburra, ouch, Kookaburra,
How your tail must hurt.

Kookaburra sits on a rusty nail,
Gets a boo-boo in his tail.
Cry, Kookaburra, cry, Kookaburra,
How life can be cruel.

title: Pirate Song
tune: Tune: traditional · lean with every direction, faster each verse

blocks.text:
'Twas a **sunny** day when I went to play,
Down by the sea.
I climbed aboard a pirate ship,
And the captain said to me:

“We're going this way, that way,
Forwards, backwards,
Up and down, up and down,
Over the deep blue sea.”
Finish by singing the captain's lines twice through, as fast as you can.

title: Scout Vespers
tune: Tune: “O Tannenbaum” · the last song, sung standing in a circle

blocks.text:
Softly falls the light of day,
While our campfire fades away.
Silently each Scout should ask,
“Have I done my daily task?

Have I kept my honour bright?
Can I guiltless sleep tonight?
Have I done and have I dared
In everything to be prepared?”

Listen, Lord, oh listen, Lord,
As I whisper soft and low.
Bless my mum and bless my dad,
There is something they should know.

I have kept my honour bright,
The Promise and Law have been my guide.
Mum and Dad, this you should know,
Deep in my heart I love you so.

title: Baby Shark
tune: Tune: traditional camp version · alligator hands, one bite per line

blocks.text:
Baby shark, dut-do dut-dut-dut-do,
Baby shark, dut-do dut-dut-dut-do,
Baby shark, dut-do dut-dut-dut-do,
Baby shark… **UHHHHH!**

blocks.heading: Repeat with
items: **Mama shark** — alligator with elbows and hands
**Hungry shark** — fin on your head, rub your stomach
**Lost a leg** — hop on one foot
**Happy shark** — fin on head and a big grin

title: Goin' On A Bear Hunt
tune: Spoken · the leader says each line, everyone echoes it back

blocks.text:
Goin' on a bear hunt,
I'm not afraid!
It's a beautiful day,
The sun is shining,
The birds are singing,
The bees are buzzing.

What's that? **Tall grass!**
_Sweep your arms, swish-swish-swish._

What's that? **A tall tree!**
_Climb all the way up, then back down._

What's that? **Ohh, it's mud!**
_March through it — slosh, slosh, slosh._

What's that? **It's a river!**
We're going to have to swim.
_Swim hard across it._

What's that? **Ohh, it's a dark cave…**
_Drop to a whisper here._

I can't see anything.
I can feel something.
I can hear something.
We'd better take out our torches.
_Click it on._
Oh — it's a bear. RUN!
Chant “I'm not afraid!” between every obstacle. Then back through the cave, the river, the mud, the tree, the grass — in reverse, at top speed.

title: Waltzing Matilda
tune: Tune: traditional Australian · chorus after every verse

blocks.text:
Once a jolly swagman camped by a billabong,
Under the shade of a coolibah tree,
And he sang as he watched and waited till his billy boiled,
“You'll come a-waltzing Matilda with me.”

Waltzing Matilda, Waltzing Matilda,
You'll come a-waltzing Matilda with me,
And he sang as he watched and waited till his billy boiled,
“You'll come a-waltzing Matilda with me.”
blocks.label: Chorus

blocks.text:
Down came a jumbuck to drink at that billabong,
Up jumped the swagman and grabbed him with glee,
And he sang as he shoved that jumbuck in his tucker bag,
“You'll come a-waltzing Matilda with me.”

Up rode the squatter, mounted on his thoroughbred,
Down came the troopers, one, two, three,
“Whose that jolly jumbuck you've got in your tucker bag?
You'll come a-waltzing Matilda with me.”

Up jumped the swagman and sprang into the billabong,
“You'll never catch me alive,” said he,
And his ghost may be heard as you pass by that billabong,
“You'll come a-waltzing Matilda with me.”

title: The Quartermaster's Store
tune: Tune: traditional marching song · chorus after every verse

blocks.text:
There was cheese, cheese, wobbling in the breeze,
In the store, in the store.
There was cheese, cheese, wobbling in the breeze,
In the Quartermaster's store.

My eyes are dim, I cannot see,
I have not brought my specs with me,
I have not brought my specs with me.
blocks.label: Chorus

blocks.heading: Then swap the cheese for
items: rats, rats, big as blooming cats
bread, bread, with great big lumps of lead
mice, mice, running through the rice
eggs, eggs, with little wooden legs
gravy, gravy, enough to sink the navy

title: Everywhere We Go
tune: Shouted echo · leader calls, everyone answers louder

blocks.text:
Everywhere we go-o, _(echo)_
People want to know-o, _(echo)_
Who we a-are, _(echo)_
So we tell them! _(echo)_

We are _(your group)_, _(echo)_
Mighty, mighty _(your group)_! _(echo)_
And if they can't hear you — round again, a little louder.

title: Down By The Bay
tune: Tune: traditional · everyone takes a turn inventing the last line

blocks.text:
Down by the bay, where the watermelons grow,
Back to my home, I dare not go.
For if I do, my mother will say:
“Did you ever see a goose, kissing a moose,
Down by the bay?”

blocks.heading: Endings to steal
items: a whale, with a polka-dot tail

title: Michael Finnegan
tune: Tune: traditional · a little faster every single time

blocks.text:
There was an old man named Michael Finnegan,
He grew whiskers on his chinnegan,
The wind came out and blew them in again,
Poor old Michael Finnegan —
**begin again!**
There is no last verse. Somebody has to be brave enough to stop it.

title: Black Socks
tune: Tune: traditional · three-part round, one group in every four beats

blocks.text:
Black socks, they never get dirty,
The longer you wear them the stronger they get.
Sometimes I think I should wash them,
But something keeps telling me: don't do it yet,
Not yet, not yet, not yet…

title: Little Peter Rabbit
tune: Tune: “Frère Jacques” · drop one word for an action each round

blocks.text:
Little Peter Rabbit had a fly upon his ear,
Little Peter Rabbit had a fly upon his ear,
Little Peter Rabbit had a fly upon his ear,
And he flicked it till it flew away.
Round two: no “rabbit” — two fingers up for ears instead. Round three: no “fly” — buzz your finger. Round four: no “flicked” — flick your ear.

title: Day Is Done
tune: Tune: “Taps” · almost a whisper, as the coals go orange

blocks.text:
Day is done, gone the sun,
From the lake, from the hills, from the sky.
All is well, safely rest,
God is nigh.

Fading light dims the sight,
And a star gems the sky, gleaming bright.
From afar, drawing nigh,
Falls the night.
